"content": "Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger: self-issue an ID-JAG, redeem it at the target authorization server (RFC 75
23), and call the MCP server with the resulting access token. See the [XAA Debugger guide](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md) for

the trust setup, registration strategies, and CI usage.

| Flag | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
--
An unknown ID, or an ID or flag for a suite the run leaves out, is a usage error (exit code `2`) before anything runs.\n\nThe OAut
h suite signs in on its own. When the server needs a sign-in for the other suites too, give them a token, for example from `oauth

login --credentials-out`:

--
| `--case <id>` | every enabled case | Run only this exact case id. Repeatable. |
| `--server <n
ame=url>` | | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL. Repeatable. Split on the first `=`; duplicate or unknown names are usage err
ors. |\n| `--mcp-config <path>` | | Explicit MCP JSON config, consulted before `./.mcp.json` and `./.mcpjam/mcp.json`. A missing o
r invalid file fails setup. |\n| `--host <template>` | none | Emulate one host template's handshake and settings. Never launches t

he real client. |
| `--inference <mode>` | `auto` | `auto`, `byok` or `mcpjam`. |
--

Global `--timeout` bounds each setup ope
ration and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usage/unsupported/import/policy, `3` credential
s, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or interrupted; see [Exit codes](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-c

odes).

***

--
`--host` as a deprecated spelling of `--client`. Passing both `--client` and
`--host` is a usage error rathe

r than a silent precedence rule.

### Editing safely: `configId` and `expectedConfigId`

--

Launch a goal run. **Spends mod

el credits**: fans out into `targets × iterations` chat sessions.

| Flag | Required | Description |
| - | - | - |
--
| `--id
empotency-key <key>` | No | Replay guard: a retry with the same key returns the run already started and starts no second runner |\
n| `--expected-sponsored <n>` | No | How many of this launch's conversations you expect to be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's per-us
er allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the launch is refused with a `409` and nothing

is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |

***

--

Each pending request holds one of the account's five concurre
nt-connection slots for up to an hour. If `connect` reports `ACTIVE_REQUEST_LIMIT`, the error details include the ids of the open

requests; cancel the abandoned ones with `connect-cancel` to free slots.

### `cloud projects servers connect-status`

--
| `
--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID |\n| `--limit <n>` | No | Revisions per page, 1 to 200 (default 50) |\n| `--curs

or <cursor>` | No | `nextCursor` from the previous page |

### `cloud projects servers revision`
--

Grade a saved server aga
inst a publisher's directory as the platform reaches it, through the saved server row and the authorize exchange. This is the host
ed half of `readiness check`: it answers a different question (what the platform sees, not what your machine sees), can optionally
run a model for experience observations (included with MCPJam; no credits are consumed), and leaves a persistent record.\n\nAll `
readiness` hosted commands require an `sk_` API key (via `--api-key` or the `MCPJAM_API_KEY` environment variable) or a prior `mcp

jam cloud login`.

--
The `mcpjam` CLI is two invocations. Local MCP testing stays at the top level: inspect, debug, and test M
CP servers from the command line or CI (connectivity, OAuth, MCP Apps, tools/resources/prompts, protocol conformance). Most local
commands are one-shot; `mcpjam mcp` and `subscriptions listen` keep a process open. Account-bound commands live under `mcpjam clou
d` and talk to your MCPJam account. There are no compatibility aliases for the old Cloud paths; see [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md).\nThese stay at the program root. They reject `--api-key` / `--api-url` / `--project`, except `
test`, which accepts them only to reach MCPJam-hosted inference.\n| [`readiness`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#readiness-
hosted-commands) | Grade a server against a publisher's directory. Hosted `start` / `status` / `list` / `cancel` / `report` stay h
ere (leaf `--api-key`; no Cloud project link) | `check`, `start claude`, `start openai`, `start muse`, `status`, `list`, `cancel`,
`report` |\nAccount-bound commands. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oa
uth login` is MCP-server OAuth; `mcpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.\n| [`cloud eval`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/referen
ce#cloud-eval-commands) | Author and run eval suites in your hosted MCPJam projects | `create`, `list`, `run`, `status` |\n| [`clo
ud tunnel`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-tunnel) | Expose a local MCP server through a public MCPJam tunnel URL, re
gistered as a server in your project | `tunnel --server <name> <url>`, `tunnel --server <name> -- <command>` |\n| [`cloud clients`
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-clients-commands) | Manage clients in your hosted MCPJam projects (`cloud hosts` is
a deprecated alias) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `servers`, `duplicate`, `delete`, `templates` |\n| [`cloud environments`]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-environments-commands) | Manage project environments, the host and server bundles eva
l suites and goals run against | `list`, `get`, `resolve`, `archive`, `ensure-adhoc` |\n| [`cloud projects servers`](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-projects-servers-commands) | Connect MCP servers to a project and manage pending connection request
s | `connect`, `connect-status`, `connect-cancel` |\n## Cloud credentials and API URL", "is_error": false}]}, "parent_tool_use_id"
